notes:
- 🎉 Reworked the reading layout so it feels like one continuous “open book” (instead of separate Wall/Shelf/Open areas)
- Your journal wall now lets you select, rename, export, and delete your entries right from the wall
- Pages supports quick access with ⌘1, taking you straight to the entries
- You can now see and interact with filter text directly in the view (with filters written like sentences you can pull off and reuse)
- ✨ Highlights and underlines are easier to spot on page cards, with underline/highlight kept while markdown syntax stays hidden by default
